rationale: Theorems (contraction, fixed point, HJ equivalence) concern the exact Bellman operator/value function; learned RL approximation only interpreted and checked numerically: non-learned guarantee, excluded.
Safety layer's sufficiency (IOB/RoC limits, IOB decay model accuracy, safe basal fallback) is asserted as ensuring safety, never stated as an assumption.
Certified violation rate is of LLM agent's emitted tool-call fields (raw text to action); detector is an embedding-similarity score, not a perception network.
Split-CRC/Clopper-Pearson from calibration samples (L_conc); bound holds for runtime enforcement that reverts flagged fields or abstains/escalates (L_mon).
Architectural guarantee about a system containing an LLM: every accepted generated refinement passes a sound subtype checker, hence deadlock-free; object identifiable.
Two-level runtime monitor filters/rejects LLM outputs before acceptance: shielding of a learned generator.
Evaluated only on MPST protocol benchmarks (literature and synthetic), no vehicle task.
Learned LLM synthesizes protocol (interaction-plan) refinements; no perception, estimation or control role applies; planning is closest.
Property enforced on every generation run: every accepted output is valid (shield-like, rule 5).
Sound checker: accepted candidates are valid, deterministic for all accepted outputs.
No threat or uncertainty model; guarantee concerns correctness of generated outputs.
Guarantee carried to system by monitor that prunes prefixes and rejects candidates failing the subtype check.
Soundness of the asynchronous subtyping checker [6] is stated (sound, not complete, size limit) but not evidenced in-paper.
Each accepted output carries a sound subtype certificate computed by the checker on the actual generated artefact.
Guarantee is a conformal error set on the learned NN residual dynamics predictor (COMP-1); planners AO-RRT/SCP are not learned.
Conformal 95% set quantifies over the distribution of residual prediction errors; consistent with agreed modality P.
Error set estimated from data (PIL-1 analogue): natural sampling variation of residual dynamics, not an a priori bounded disturbance.
Conformal set computed from errors against Vicon motion-capture ground truth on the real Leo rover; hardware experiments reported.
